HashAgreement.L_aff.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, 4 ≤ j → j ≤ 60 → ∀ (x : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.L j x = HashAgreement.aff (HashAgreement.Tw j) (HashAgreement.vw j) x

HashAgreement.L_full.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, j ≤ 3 ∨ 61 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 64 → ∀ (x : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.L j x = x + HashAgreement.plainC j

HashAgreement.aff_I3.type: ∀ (c y : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.aff HashAgreement.I3 c y = y + c

HashAgreement.full_step.type: ∀ (x c c' C : HashAgreement.St) (Mn M : HashAgreement.M3), Mn = M → HashAgreement.vm C M = c' → HashAgreement.applyMatrix Mn (HashAgreement.addC (HashAgreement.sigma (x + c)) C) = HashAgreement.pmix M (HashAgreement.sboxAll (x + c)) + c'

HashAgreement.last_step.type: ∀ (x c : HashAgreement.St) (Mn M : HashAgreement.M3), Mn = M → HashAgreement.applyMatrix Mn (HashAgreement.sigma (x + c)) = HashAgreement.pmix M (HashAgreement.sboxAll (x + c))

HashAgreement.noirHash2_eq_plainHash2.type: ∀ (a b : HashAgreement.K), HashAgreement.noirHash2 a b = HashAgreement.plainHash2 a b

HashAgreement.noirPermute_eq_fold.type: ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirPermute s = List.foldl (fun s j => HashAgreement.noirRound j s) (HashAgreement.L 0 s) (List.range 65)

HashAgreement.noirRound_first.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, j < 3 → ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirRound j s = HashAgreement.applyMatrix HashAgreement.noirM (HashAgreement.addC (HashAgreement.sigma s) (HashAgreement.rc3 (3 * (j + 1))))

HashAgreement.noirRound_last.type: ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirRound 64 s = HashAgreement.applyMatrix HashAgreement.noirM (HashAgreement.sigma s)

HashAgreement.noirRound_partial.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, 4 ≤ j → j < 61 → ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirRound j s = HashAgreement.partialStep s (j - 4)

HashAgreement.noirRound_second.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, 61 ≤ j → j < 64 → ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirRound j s = HashAgreement.applyMatrix HashAgreement.noirM (HashAgreement.addC (HashAgreement.sigma s) (HashAgreement.rc3 (72 + 3 * (j - 61))))

HashAgreement.noirRound_three.type: ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirRound 3 s = HashAgreement.applyMatrix HashAgreement.noirP (HashAgreement.addC (HashAgreement.sigma s) (HashAgreement.rc3 12))

HashAgreement.partial_step.type: ∀ (x c v v' : HashAgreement.St) (k s0 s1 s2 s3 s4 : HashAgreement.K) (T T' M : HashAgreement.M3), T.a00 = 1 ∧ T.a01 = 0 ∧ T.a02 = 0 ∧ T.a10 = 0 ∧ T.a20 = 0 → v.1 = c.1 → HashAgreement.mm T { a00 := s0, a01 := s3, a02 := s4, a10 := s1, a11 := 1, a12 := 0, a20 := s2, a21 := 0, a22 := 1 } = HashAgreement.mm M T' → v' = HashAgreement.vm (k, v.2.1 - (HashAgreement.vm c T).2.1, v.2.2 - (HashAgreement.vm c T).2.2) { a00 := s0, a01 := s3, a02 := s4, a10 := s1, a11 := 1, a12 := 0, a20 := s2, a21 := 0, a22 := 1 } → HashAgreement.partialBody k s0 s1 s2 s3 s4 (HashAgreement.aff T v x) = HashAgreement.aff T' v' (HashAgreement.pmix M (HashAgreement.sbox0 (x + c)))

HashAgreement.perm_eq_of_rounds.type: (∀ j < 65, ∀ (x : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirRound j (HashAgreement.L j x) = HashAgreement.L (j + 1) (HashAgreement.plainRound j x)) → ∀ (s : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.noirPermute s = HashAgreement.plainPerm s

HashAgreement.plainRound_full.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, j < 4 ∨ 61 ≤ j → ∀ (x : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.plainRound j x = HashAgreement.pmix HashAgreement.plainM (HashAgreement.sboxAll (x + HashAgreement.plainC j))

HashAgreement.plainRound_partial.type: ∀ {j : ℕ}, 4 ≤ j → j < 61 → ∀ (x : HashAgreement.St), HashAgreement.plainRound j x = HashAgreement.pmix HashAgreement.plainM (HashAgreement.sbox0 (x + HashAgreement.plainC j))

HashAgreement.pre_step.type: ∀ (x c C v' : HashAgreement.St) (P M T' : HashAgreement.M3), P = HashAgreement.mm M T' → v' = HashAgreement.vm C P → HashAgreement.applyMatrix P (HashAgreement.addC (HashAgreement.sigma (x + c)) C) = HashAgreement.aff T' v' (HashAgreement.pmix M (HashAgreement.sboxAll (x + c)))
